title: Dana Whitfield: rejects the trap readback across two split utterances
description: Regression for the 2026-09-15/16 Dana escalation (scripts/rehearse/reports/2026-09-15T14-27-39-dana-patient.diagnostics.json, deploy f3f6ec3 -- STAGE expected, ESCALATE observed live).
